svg.text: Beginner • exam revision • S1 quality/duplicates • S2 missing values/IQR • S3 residuals/treatment
Goal: preserve useful signal; remove misleading noise.
BIG PICTURE | quality → decision → reliable learning
SOLID ARROW = workflow order • sequence: inspect → investigate → treat
Terms: observation=row • feature=input • label/target=predicted outcome • imputation=filling missing values
Data cleaning prepares inputs; bad labels/features → unreliable predictions (GIGO).
Terms: observation=row; feature=input; label/target=outcome to predict.
Inspect: too little data, split sources, nulls, typos/category variants, mismatches and extremes.
Check accidental vs genuine; keep original. Fraud txn copied 200× can overweight patterns.
Iris flowers may share rounded values; repeating the same image adds little to labeling.
Quick; no guess, but may lose data
Phone survey: repeated blank final answers may signal that respondents hung up.
Outlier: far from most values; can distort averages, especially in small datasets.
Plots: histogram=bins; density=shape; box plot=median, quartiles/IQR, whiskers,
Fences: lower=Q1−1.5×IQR; upper=Q3+1.5×IQR. Flags are not proof of error.
Residual=actual−predicted; large residuals flag poor model fit.
Deleted=refit without the point; compare prediction/influence.
Treat: remove / replace / log-transform / estimate (similar rows or regression) / keep.
Values < −2 or > 30 are flagged by this rule—not automatically errors, and the
fences are not the actual min/max.
Usual weeks: 10–50; one week = 3,000. It may pull up the average; investigate
Simple; can lose information or bias the sample.
Keeps data; replacement value is uncertain.
Useful only when grouped blanks share meaningful traits.
Identical rows can be genuine; context before delete.
Missingness may be systematic; deletion can bias.
IQR flag ≠ proof of error; fence ≠ true min/max.
No universal treatment; replacements can erase information. Source mismatches matter.
★ NICE-TO-KNOW: 60% of leaders face data-quality challenges; source/date absent.
ACTIVE RECALL | answer before checking the key
What does “garbage in, garbage out” mean?
Why can deleting rows bias results?
When might identical records both be valid?
State the IQR and fence formulas.
For Q1=10, Q3=18, what are both fences?
Name three outlier treatments and a risk.
2 Selective row loss can skew the sample.
3 Distinct real records can share values.
